decisionsTitle: The group run's signing page types its birth date day first, as the registration form does
decisionsSection:
**Context.** §561 (BR-V2.35) replaced the browser's own `type="date"` box on the registration form and the desk with `BirthDateField`: typed day first, «11.05.1990», whatever language the browser speaks, the date in words with the age on the event's day as the box's helper, the minimum age refused live under it, and the server reading the typed text with `normalizeTypedDate`. The public group-run signing page (§393), which asks a birth date only when the run's minimum age is above eighteen (§440, §515), still drew the native date box — so an English phone showed it month first, the defect §561 fixed everywhere else.

**Decision.** The signing page draws the same `BirthDateField` (id and name `birthDate`, so the refusal summary's link and the sealed draft keep working): the same `DD.MM.YYYY` / `ZZ.LL.AAAA` placeholder and unreadable-date words from the `Registration` catalogue, the same echo template, the oldest bound a hundred and twenty years back as on the registration form, the youngest the run's own (`latestBirthDateFor` on the run's day, today at the latest). At rest the helper is the page's own «Pentru vârsta minimă a alergării…» line with the date in words under it; a whole date under the run's minimum turns the box red and puts the page's «Vârsta minimă pentru această alergare este {age}…» sentence first, and the server's refusal reads the same until the box is typed in again. The action reads the box with `normalizeTypedDate`, so the service still gets `YYYY-MM-DD` — or what was typed, trimmed, for `birthDateRefusal` to name — and a browser without JavaScript posts what it typed and is read the same. No new words: every string the box needs was already in both catalogues.

**Not done.** No MUI picker (it stays off public pages, `pickers-backoffice-only.test.ts`), and no change to what the service refuses or stores: the date is still counted against the run's minimum and dropped (§440).
changelogLine: - **The group run's declaration types the birth date day first** — «11.05.1990» on an English phone too, with the date in words and the age on the run's day under the box, and the run's minimum age said there as soon as a younger date is typed, as on the registration form. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Amends criterion 39. Given a group run whose minimum age is above eighteen, when its signing page renders, then the birth date is the registration form's typed box (BR-REQ-031-04 criteria 36–38): a text box, never the browser's date box, read and shown day first in both languages («11051990» and «11/05/1990» are 11 May, shown «11.05.1990»), with the placeholder «ZZ.LL.AAAA» / «DD.MM.YYYY», the date in words with the age on the run's day as its helper, and a whole date under the run's minimum refused live under the box with «Vârsta minimă pentru această alergare este {age}…». The press reads the typed text with the same `normalizeTypedDate`, so the service gets `YYYY-MM-DD` (2026-09-30, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `group-run-declarations/birth-date-day-first.test.ts`; e2e `group-run-declaration.spec.ts`.
